verdict.rationale: Decagon documents Simulations, an integrated testing suite that validates agent behavior across channels before deploying to production, and Duet-generated tests. Together these give a first-party pre-production test path. However, this is simulated-conversation testing (closer to a dry run), not a documented isolated sandbox environment. Nothing shows that integrations or actions run against non-production data, and Experiments explicitly run 'directly in production'. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or staging environment isolated from production systems, mocked or test-data integrations so simulated tool calls don't touch real customer data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Simulations, Decagon's integrated testing suite, help teams validate agent behavior across channels before deploying to production and with every subsequent update.
Use Duet to easily generate tests covering diverse pathways that verify whether agents respond accurately, follow policies, and reflect your brand.
